name: @fl03/harness-pi
description: Pi coding agent adapter: materializes @fl03/compiler's `pi` emission target (prompts/*.md slash commands, skills/*/SKILL.md) to disk, builds the per-role `pi` subprocess invocation (--model/--tools/--append-system-prompt, since Pi has no file-declared-role primitive and setModel() is session-global), and interprets content/predicates/*.toml directly in a jiti-loaded TypeScript extension (pi.on('tool_call', ...)) -- Pi has no hooks.json module, so this is a genuine second guard interpreter, not a file copy. Implemented in Wave 4 (W4-S6).
